name: @zboule/wasp-runner
description: The wasp engine: runs agent turns on AgentCore, drains a thread's queue, writes its feed

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=image/runner.mjs --external:@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.image: pnpm build && docker build --platform linux/arm64 -t wasp-runner:local image
